question: What exalted status does the bearer of this supreme holy armor attain?
premises: The armor is supreme and holy
The bearer is compared to meritorious ones
inference: He is also the best among the meritorious.
uncertainties: Token split puṇyavatā/ vvaraḥ may reflect sandhi or line break in source.
plain_english: This is the supreme holy armor, and he is also the best among the meritorious.
